description: Source code for a base data reader class and an upload command class used in the Superset project for uploading data files (CSV, Excel, etc.) to a database, including validation, reading, and metadata handling.

classes.name: UploadFileType
classes.description: Enumeration for supported upload file types (csv, excel, columnar).

classes.name: ReaderOptions
classes.description: TypedDict for options when reading files, such as whether the file already exists, index label, and dataframe index.

classes.name: FileMetadataItem
classes.description: TypedDict representing metadata for a file sheet, including sheet name and column names.

classes.name: FileMetadata
classes.description: TypedDict containing a list of FileMetadataItems.

classes.name: BaseDataReader
classes.description: Abstract base class for reading data from files and uploading to a database, with methods for converting files to dataframes and extracting metadata.

classes.name: UploadCommand
classes.description: Command class for handling the process of uploading a data file to a database, including validation, reading, and metadata fetching.

methods.name: file_to_dataframe
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a file to a pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: file_metadata
methods.description: Abstract method to extract metadata from a file.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a file and uploads its data to the specified database table.

methods.name: _dataframe_to_database
methods.description: Uploads a pandas DataFrame to the database table, handling exceptions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the upload process, including validation, normalization, reading, and metadata fetching.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the database model and upload permissions.
